annotations.title: Export a Studio ZIP, Mobile ZIP, or Data JSON

description: Exports one owned Studio source ZIP, Mobile Expo project ZIP, or Data project JSON snapshot. The only action is export. Use export to download that package. Use project to read or save the draft in place, database to query records, files for private file bytes, and eas_dispatch to start a customer Expo workflow. Export does not start an EAS build, publish a site, or run a server. Code has no server-side export. Cloud does not export a Node app.

product.description: studio, mobile, or data export. code and cloud are accepted and refused. code stays in the browser. Cloud does not export a Node app.

projectId.description: UUID of the Studio project, Mobile project, or Data project this account owns.
